Systems Administrator - Microsoft 365

Purpose of the role:
The Systems Administrator is responsible for the day to day operation and
administration of the organisation's Microsoft 365 environment.

Key responsibilities:
- Creates, amends and disables user accounts as part of the joiners, movers
  and leavers process.
- Resets passwords and re-registers multi-factor authentication methods for
  staff who have lost access to their devices.
- Manages membership of distribution lists and Microsoft 365 groups.
- Delegates access to mailboxes when a member of staff is on extended leave,
  and removes that access on their return.
- Configures and deploys device compliance policies in Intune and monitors
  the resulting compliance reporting.
- Enrols and retires corporate mobile devices.
- Produces monthly reporting on licence allocation and consumption.
- Investigates and responds to reported phishing emails, including searching
  for and removing malicious messages from mailboxes across the tenant.
- Maintains the organisation's data loss prevention policies.
- Acts as an escalation point for the service desk and participates in the
  out of hours on-call rota.
- Liaises with third party suppliers on support contracts and licensing.
